THEARCHITECT-WRATH.title: Wrath
THEARCHITECT-WRATH.description: After playing this card, enter [gold]Wrath[/gold]: your Attacks deal [b]50%[/b] more damage and you take [b]50%[/b] more damage from enemies. Lasts until you enter another stance.
THEARCHITECT-CALM.title: Calm
THEARCHITECT-CALM.description: After playing this card, enter [gold]Calm[/gold]. When you leave Calm for another stance, gain [b]1[/b] [gold]Energy[/gold]. Entering Calm again does not count as leaving it.
